Context: 16. Voluntary Retirement/ Resignation

## 16. Voluntary Retirement/ Resignation  
- (a) Notice of Voluntary Retirement Under FR 56 (k) or Rule 43 of CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021-  
lt shall be open to the Appropriate Authority to withhold permission to a Government servant under suspension who seeks to retire  
under either of these rules.  
- Proviso (c) of FR 56 (k) (1) (c) and Rule 43 (3) of CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021.
